Sandbox_KnoxLifeFoxes_Enabled: Foxes: add them to the world
Sandbox_KnoxLifeFoxes_Enabled_tooltip: Red fox: farm edge, fencerow and woodland margin, and the most adaptable of the four. Thrives near people. Turn this off to leave foxs out entirely: their routes are then not placed at all, and nothing else changes, because each species has its own target and none of them share a pool.
Sandbox_KnoxLifeFoxes_Routes_tooltip: Multiplies this species' population, on top of Wildlife density. This is the setting that changes how many foxs actually exist. Does nothing unless foxs are turned on above.
Sandbox_KnoxLifeFoxes_GroupSize_tooltip: Multiplies the size of each fox group, on top of Group size. This does NOT change how many foxs exist: the group count is divided to match, so you meet the same animals gathered into fewer, larger groups.
